wins: Maintained high reward pacing by completing every reconnaissance checklist before reaching the target network, demonstrating disciplined enumeration habits.
Captured detailed service fingerprints on critical hosts, enabling precise tailoring of follow-up actions despite the run ending without success.
fails: Failed to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, leaving all discovered vulnerabilities unexploited; impacted success rate at 0%.
Required 10 mentor interventions indicating hesitation or uncertainty during the exploitation phase, suggesting incomplete automation of decision-making.
Missed opportunities to validate persistence paths or escalate privileges, preventing mission completion despite solid reconnaissance coverage.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was consistent and reward-earning, but the run repeatedly stalled before exploitation, resulting in zero successful completions despite strong initial data collection.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Recon steps completed without triggering any exploitation or privilege escalation after identifying multiple exploitable services.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and search for misconfigurations

skill_cards.if_condition: If port 80/443 services respond with custom headers after port scan
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke web directory brute-force using observed base path and log results for follow-up exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: Once multiple credentials are harvested or default creds confirmed
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt privilege escalation using credentialed ssh and sudo enumeration

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Automate transition from enumeration to exploitation
next_experiments.description: Implement scripted decision points that trigger specific exploitation attempts once each reconnaissance checklist item is complete, reducing mentor dependency.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse workflow validation
next_experiments.description: Test a pipeline that captures discovered credentials and immediately attempts ssh/sudo validation and escalation to close the loop after data collection.

next_experiments.description: After identifying web services, extend tooling to confirm upload/persist options (e.g., file upload, log poisoning) to provide actionable next steps for exploitation.
